description:
LANDED f69c5ea26 (2026-09-02; refuter FIX-THEN-MERGE, five fixes folded
-- the real one: eager env validation at CLI dispatch, so a typo'd
setting fails EVERY run with a usage diagnostic instead of lazily
panicking only on runs that reach a perturbation site, which the
refuter measured letting a typo sweep green on 421/584 fixtures.
Gate lib 1564/0/5, cli 24/0, matrix 446/0/9).

TWO PERMUTATION POINTS, both refuter-verified sound: arms at
callsite_dispatch::arrival_order BEFORE the seat (covers-proven
inversions are deterministic, so seeds vary exactly the arrival-kept
residue); wrappers in jobs/runtime_demand.rs wrapping
callable_flow_resolution_edges_product BEFORE first_class_edges is
stored -- upstream of the body_id weld (fz-kdt.108's prescribed
point; every consumer re-read, no index-parallel assumption broken).
FACT STABILITY PROVEN: determinism pair green under 9 settings;
cross-process double-compiles byte-identical (584 x 4 settings);
job-span counts IDENTICAL under every setting (the perturbation moves
order and nothing else). Grammar: seeds / arms: / wrappers: /
reverse / comma-joined; ""/0/unset off (triple-proven inert incl.
base-vs-head knob-off 0/584x2); arms:reverse == the retired knob
byte-for-byte; single-transposition guarantee (a seed never names the
settled order -- counterfactual measured: without it 16/19 wrapper
fixtures go inert).

CATCHES (all refuter-reproduced): 4 native aborts, all fz-kdt.107
step-3's declared class, under seeds the old reversal never produced
(enum_map_family, 00277, dispatch_seat_element_blind,
enum_predicate_search; JIT+AOT agree; debug seat-invariant live
during all -- legal orders reaching a latent miscompile, not stress
artifacts; element kinds: atoms x2, bitstrings, structs).
fz-kdt.132's expected catch HONESTLY NEGATIVE (wrapper seeds swap its
selection nodes -- 972 canon lines -- but reordering makes the dead
member live INSTEAD of its sibling, never alongside: the break needs
different VALUES, which is fz-kdt.138's test; 0 matched-no-member
over 584x7x2 -- fz-kdt.136's premise refuted, that ticket closes as
folded here). NEW FIND fz-kdt.147: the 268-hit tripwire baseline is
WRAPPER-ORDER-DECIDED (268 settled -> 68 -> 20 across seeds, nothing
above 268 over 13 seeds; arm seeds move it ZERO) -- the settled mint
order is the WORST legal order; connects to fz-kdt.108's canonical
edge order, which now has a quality dimension (pick the
escape-minimizing covering order, the 129 law applied to members).

GATES: 6 unit + 2 census corpus gates (~85s serial, absorbed by lib
parallelism); ARM_ORDER_CENSUS deliberately stays the 14
indistinguishable-group carriers (the 13 other artifact-movers are
covered by the doc'd canon-comparand sweep -- subset reasoning now in
its doc); sweep recipe corrected to capture exit status and to name
the canon comparand for the artifact-mover table. fz-kdt.107 step 3
is UNBLOCKED.

comments.text:
BUILT at 55a2128ad (worktree wt-kdt141-build, off 949dfce65). Not pushed.

THE TWO PERMUTATION POINTS.

(1) ARMS -- callsite_dispatch::arrival_order, before routable_alternatives/specificity_order. The seat is left untouched: covers-proven inversions are deterministic facts about the arms, so permuting arrival perturbs exactly the residue the seat declines to decide (a question group's members, and every neither-covers pair). Confirmed empirically: several seeds produce orders the seat maps straight back to the settled seat.

(2) WRAPPERS -- jobs/runtime_demand.rs, wrapping callable_flow_resolution_edges_product's result before flow.first_class_edges is stored. This is fz-kdt.108's prescribed point and the ONLY sound one: the selection row's body_id is welded to the member's index (NonMonotonicBodyId), so permuting the edges before members, selection, boundary_resolution_symbols_for_flow_surfaces and the resolution list all derive keeps the weld and needs no consumer change. Nothing was blocked; the fz-kdt.108 refactor was not needed. The permutation is a pure function of (seed, len), so a perturbed fact is stable across recomputation and nothing oscillates.

INTERFACE: FZ_STRESS_PERMUTE_DISPATCH replaces FZ_STRESS_REVERSE_DISPATCH_ARMS outright (grammar: unset/""/"0" off; <seed>; arms:<seed>; wrappers:<seed>; reverse; arms:reverse == the retired knob; comma-joined clauses). Unrecognized settings PANIC -- a stress that sweeps inertly reads as green. A seed never names the settled order (a fair shuffle of two items -- most free orders here -- comes out settled half the time).

RED FIRST, both halves captured at base:
- a_seed_moves_an_arrival_order_the_group_reversal_cannot + no_setting_asks_for_anything_but_the_settled_order both FAIL with the Seeded arm of arrival_order stubbed to Cow::Borrowed ('a seeded permutation must reach the arrival-decided residue the group mirror leaves untouched').
- compiler2_a_permuted_wrapper_order_reseats_the_construction_members FAILS with perturbed_construction_members stubbed to identity.

WHAT IT CATCHES (584 fixtures; interp+JIT whole-corpus, AOT over both censuses).
- Artifact reach: arms:reverse 8 fixtures, arms:<seed> 27, wrappers:<seed> 19, unset == "" == "0" byte-identical (0).
- Interp: 0 movers under 19 settings.
- Native: FOUR fixtures abort, ONE signature (_fz_list_head_int_ref, list-of-atoms read as ints), all fz-kdt.107 step 3. enum_map_family (arms:reverse, arms:6 -- the only one reversal ever aborted); 00277_enum_tier0_fixture (arms:1..5); dispatch_seat_element_blind (every arm seed); enum_predicate_search (arms:6). JIT and AOT agree fixture for fixture. NO new defect class -- all four are fz-kdt.107's declared population; commented there.
- Wrapper half, HONEST NEGATIVE: it reaches fz-kdt.132's pair (enum_take_drop_split's selection test nodes swap, 972 canon lines) but produces no 'matched no member' at any seed on any door, and CANNOT: reordering makes the dead member live INSTEAD of its sibling, and a member that takes everything marshals its own return form consistently. fz-kdt.136's expected catch is refuted by measurement; commented on 132 and 136.
- NEW FIND, filed as fz-kdt.147: the whole 268-escape FZ_STRESS_ASSERT_SURFACE_MEMBERSHIP baseline is wrapper-order-decided -- 268 settled, 68 at wrappers:1, 20 at wrappers:6, five of seven fixtures to ZERO, enum_take_drop_split 106->34->10 -- while arm seeds move it by ZERO. The settled mint order is the WORST of the legal orders measured, on identical stdout everywhere.

GATES ADDED: compiler2_dispatch_answers_the_same_under_a_permuted_arm_order (census 14 x arms:reverse/1/6), ..._under_a_permuted_wrapper_order (census 19 x wrappers:1/6), compiler2_a_permuted_wrapper_order_reseats_the_construction_members (the perturbation LANDS), compiler2_jit_halts_a_reduce_under_every_arm_order (widened from two orders to four), plus four unit gates. Sweep recipe + every number in .agent/docs/dispatch-matrix.md.

VERIFIED: lib 1564/0/5 (base 1558/0/5, +6), cli 24/0, matrix --test-threads=1 446/0/9, cargo fmt clean, cargo clippy --all-targets -D warnings clean, release builds. Inertness proven twice: unset vs ""/"0" 0 canon movers, and base(949dfce65) vs head with the knob unset 0 movers over 584 fixtures x 2 doors on stdout, exit AND backend canon.

DEVIATION: none requiring authorization. The one design call worth flagging is that seeds are guaranteed non-settled by a single transposition when the shuffle lands on identity -- without it, wrappers:2 and wrappers:3 were measured INERT on every two-member wrapper.

fz-kdt.136 is folded here and can close on this landing. fz-kdt.107 step 3 is unblocked.
